action.objective: Broad-search all legal root moves at depth 4 to find tactics and the strongest continuation after Black's c6.
action.rationale: First action requires candidate_moves=[]. Black just played c7c6 attacking the d7 knight and b5 bishop, while the d6 bishop pins nothing but eyes d7. Need complete root coverage at target depth 4 (half of 6000 nodes) to identify captures like Bxc6, Nxf8, Nxd5 and queen moves before selecting a candidate to verify.
